g.text: Title: Haptic bracelet - UART ring wiring

g.text: One wrist / ring pod schematic draft

g.desc: One wrist / ring pod schematic draft

g.text: Each pod: M2003FC1AE + DRV2625 + LRA. Pod 0 shares its housing with the ESP32/power electronics.

g.desc: Each pod: M2003FC1AE + DRV2625 + LRA. Pod 0 shares its housing with the ESP32/power electronics.

g.text: IN/OUT: 1 switched 3V3, 2 GND, 3 DATA, 4 MCU reset, 5 VBAT_RAW (parallel cell bus).

g.desc: IN/OUT: 1 switched 3V3, 2 GND, 3 DATA, 4 MCU reset, 5 VBAT_RAW (parallel cell bus).

g.text: ESP TX -> D0 -> pod 0 -> D1 -> ... -> pod 7 -> D8 -> ESP RX

g.desc: ESP TX -> D0 -> pod 0 -> D1 -> ... -> pod 7 -> D8 -> ESP RX

g.text: VBAT_RAW, switched 3V3, ground and reset are common; DATA is point-to-point.

g.desc: VBAT_RAW, switched 3V3, ground and reset are common; DATA is point-to-point.

g.text: Each fitted cell joins VBAT_RAW through its own nearby fuse. Main positive-path pack protection feeds BAT_PROTECTED.

g.desc: Each fitted cell joins VBAT_RAW through its own nearby fuse. Main positive-path pack protection feeds BAT_PROTECTED.
